description: Fetch the user's credit balance and recent usage entries. Returns { credits, recent } where recent is the last ~10 usage rows. Poll this to confirm a top-up landed ONLY after a billing_topup CHECKOUT result (one that returned a checkoutUrl), until credits rise. Do NOT poll after a status:'paid' headless top-up — those credits are already applied and the new balance is in the topup response.
name: billing_wallet
